PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
UI engineer with five years building component-driven web applications
using Meta's declarative UI library and JSX. Writes fully typed code in
the typed superset of JavaScript, styles with modern layout primitives,
and keeps interfaces fast, accessible, and covered by automated checks.

SKILLS
- UI: Meta's component-based UI library, JSX, hooks, context, suspense
- Types: the typed superset of JavaScript with strict compiler settings
- Styling: utility-class frameworks, grid and flexbox layouts, design
  tokens, responsive breakpoints, dark-mode theming
- Quality: component-level automated checks with a modern rendering
  harness, snapshot review, accessibility audits
- Tooling: next-generation ESM dev server and bundler, monorepo task
  runners, bundle analysis and code-splitting
